content.short: Supra is a fast, vertically integrated MultiVM Layer-1 with a suite of powerful native services.
content.description: Supra is a high-performance, vertically-integrated MultiVM Layer-1 blockchain designed for speed and scale. Initially powered by MoveVM, Supra can process up to 500,000 TPS across 300 globally distributed nodes with sub-second consensus latency. It features native oracle price feeds, on-chain randomness, cross-chain communication, and automation—all on a single platform. EVM and SolanaVM support are coming soon, providing developers with a unified environment to build Super dApps.
